fields.label: Tokenizer
fields.readOnlyReason: Python expression (tiktoken object). Edit the config file directly to change this value.
fields.help: The tiktoken encoding used to count tokens per chunk. Currently set via tiktoken.get_encoding("cl100k_base"). This determines how text is tokenized for length measurement.

fields.label: Max Tokens per Node
fields.help: Maximum token count allowed in a single chunk node before the chunker splits it. Higher values produce larger chunks with more context but may reduce retrieval precision.

fields.label: Chunk Size Range
fields.readOnlyReason: Derived automatically from MAX_TOKENS_FOR_NODE via an f-string expression.
fields.help: An f-string expression that resolves to the max token constraint string (e.g. "max=500"). It changes automatically when you update Max Tokens per Node.

fields.label: Chunk Model
fields.help:
Chunking strategy that controls how text is divided.

• heading-safe — preserves markdown heading boundaries so chunks align with document structure.
• greedy — maximizes chunk size up to the token limit, splitting only when necessary.
• fixed — uses fixed-size token windows with no awareness of document structure.

fields.label: Code Length (lines)
fields.help: Minimum number of lines for a code block to be treated as a standalone extractable unit. Code blocks shorter than this are kept inline with surrounding text.

fields.label: Keyword Density
fields.help: Threshold ratio of keyword tokens to total tokens in a chunk. Chunks with a density above this value may be flagged or handled differently during processing.

fields.label: Enable Code Extraction
fields.help: When enabled, code blocks meeting the Code Length threshold are extracted into separate chunks. Disable this to skip component extraction during testing or for text-only content.

fields.label: Output File Name
fields.help: Base filename for the chunker output JSON file. The file is written to the dataset output directory.
